question: With what should the bali offering to Rājarājeśvara also be made?
premises: The verse refers to Rājarājeśvara as the recipient.
It prescribes offering bali to him as well.
It specifies using that same vessel.
inference: The bali offering to Rājarājeśvara should also be made with that same bali vessel.
plain_english: One should also cause the bali offering to Rājarājeśvara to be made with that same vessel.
